name: Zoom Meeting Web Client
description: Receives and parses Zoom Web Client meeting events (speaker, mute, video, participants, chat) sent over WebSocket

activeSpeaker.description: Name of the current active speaker in the Zoom meeting

muted.description: Whether the local Zoom microphone is muted

videoOff.description: Whether the local Zoom camera is turned off

participantsCount.description: Current number of participants in the Zoom meeting

lastChatSender.description: Sender of the most recent Zoom chat message

lastChatMessage.description: Text of the most recent Zoom chat message

event.description: Last event type received from the Zoom injector (connectionStatus, stateUpdate, chatMessage)

error.description: Error message reported by the Zoom Web Client injector

onChatMessage.description: Triggered when a new Zoom chat message is received

onStateChanged.description: Triggered when muted, videoOff, activeSpeaker, or participantsCount changes

responseReceived.description: Triggered whenever a WebSocket message arrives from the Zoom Web Client
